text:
Marie: Heads-up — planning a quick warmup run for ACME's dedicated pool tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Main goals: quota validation, autoscale sanity, and a 30m steady-state soak. Ping if timing clashes.
Ajay: 👍 I can own infra. Which GPU profile and slot count are we priming?
Marie: Using r-infer-prod-g4dnx8, start with 8 slots (customer committed 6 but we want headroom). Target latency SLO 95p < 200ms for 128-token gen.
Cara: I'll run enablement with ACME and confirm they can toggle traffic. I have a quick enablement doc — will DM.
Dmitri: From the account point-of-view: want to validate rate-limits and quota boundaries so their client SDK doesn't hit 429s during ramp. Can we keep a thin margin?
Ajay: We'll set quota to 1.5x expected steady qps for the test. Autoscale policy = "burst-safe-v2" (min 4, desired 8, max 12). That should avoid cold-starts.
Marie: Nice. Test plan: 1) smoke (5m) at 0.5x qps, 2) ramp to 1x over 10m, 3) hold 30m at 1x with occasional 2x spikes, 4) spike to 3x for 5m then back down. Output: per-route latency, 429/5xx counts, and cost delta.
Cara: I'll collect a small prompt set for quality regressions and run a few sample traces during soak. Any special hooks we need for logs?
Ajay: Enable token-level tracing on the pool and route-level metrics. Add KV cache hits metric too. Command I'll run for the load generator:
Ajay: ```artillery quick --count 1000 -n 100 
# config: threads=32, think=30ms, payload=prompts.json```
Dmitri: Can we get a pre-test checklist so I can run it with ACME ops? They want a one-pager.
Marie: I'll draft and post in the channel. Minimal checklist: 1) API keys, 2) route pinned to dedicated pool, 3) SDK version >= 2.4, 4) emergency cutoff contact, 5) KMS access validated.
OpsBot: Deployment event: dedicated-pool/prime-435 created by ajay at 1715005080 — warmup nodes provisioning started. :rocket:
Ajay: Provisioning looks good so far, a few GPUs still initializing (~3m). I’ll update once all green.
Cara: Scheduling customer call at 08:30 UTC to run through checklist — invite sent to ACME ops.
Dmitri: Great, thanks. Also flagging renewal team — we should capture any perf concerns during the soak to avoid surprises in next QBR.
Marie: Agreed — I'll add a feedback capture sheet and tag renewal. After soak we'll share the per-route dashboards and a short exec summary. :sparkles:
Ajay: All set from infra side. If we see >1% 5xx we'll abort and rollback to shared pool.
Marie: Copy. See you all tomorrow.
